name: Archmage's Tower
description: An impossibly tall spire that pierces the heavens and resonates with immense power.

features.name: Mystical Defenses
features.description: Countdown (12). To climb the tower, the PCs must complete the countdown. On a failure or a roll with Fear, they trigger one of the archmage’s many arcane traps and hazards, taking 3d10 magic damage. On a failure with Fear, the damage dealt gains a bonus equal to the PC’s level.
features.prompt: What do the designs of the archmage’s defenses tell you about their specific area of expertise? What signature style or flourish do the traps and hazards all share?

features.name: Archmage’s Aerie
features.description: The top floor of the tower is a many-chambered laboratory, library, and workshop containing everything needed to study magic in its highest forms. A PC with a Spellcast Trait can make a Knowledge Roll to partake in the archmage’s research. On a success, they gain a +1 bonus to their Spellcast Rolls until their next long rest. On a failure, their investigation goes wrong, and they take 3d8+4 magic damage.
features.prompt: What part of the aerie calls to you? What do the archmage’s notes reveal to you?

features.name: Amalgamated Adversaries
features.description: Spend a Fear to summon two adversaries within Close range of a PC. Each adversary can use the other’s features as if they were their own.
features.prompt: Which creatures has the archmage chosen to combine? What do they hope to learn in doing so?
